question: After removing the measured model-scale common drift, does the finite-age raw-vs-no-momentum rate structure replicate across fresh seeds at 7B, and is the same decomposition informative for a 27B LoRA arm?

forbidden_now: create a v15 result root, attempt directory, launch manifest, queue, or controller
start or reserve any H200 process
replace multi-seed evidence with the one-seed G9 interval
make the arm-relative verdict conditional on the absolute verdict
future_launch_prerequisites: a clean pushed descendant preserving this scientific contract
a hash-frozen analyzer mechanically implementing both independent gates
loss-blind materialization and launch manifests for exactly the registered cells
a separate explicit launch authority created before any v15 loss exists
authority.outcome_aware_changes_forbidden: No model, horizon, arm, seed, grid, drift correction, band, gate multiplicity rule, or relative/absolute independence rule may change after any v15 endpoint exists.

source.canonical_location: /root/g9-joint-readout.json in the original control plane; missing from the CPU evacuation archive

measured_drift_calibration.interpretation: This is an empirical two-point common-mode calibration, not a universal model-scaling law. The 27B value is explicitly an extrapolation and the LoRA regime may differ.

bands.absolute_derivation: round outward from 4*abs(-0.548779-(-0.496872))=0.207628 bits after extracting the measured 7B common mode
bands.separation_rule: The absolute and arm-relative bands define different gates. Passing or failing either gate cannot alter the other gate's evaluability, arithmetic, or verdict.

common_outer_protocol.outer_optimizer: production raw Nesterov for mu=.9; identical implementation with mu=0 for reference

eta_grid.exact_values: enumerated under registered_grids.qwen2p5_7b_full in the hash-bound gatesim report

center_derivation.T5: the G9 fitted values are calibration-only placements; v15 repeats them with three new seeds and a wider six-rung ladder
center_derivation.mu0_T2_T20: transport T5 with the frozen 1.7B fixed-H mu0 slope -0.756529843311295 in log eta versus log T
center_derivation.raw_T2_T20: transport the measured T5 raw/mu0 ratio by the frozen G6-selected F3 D(T,S=512T) ratio
center_derivation.claim_boundary: Because the -0.50 correction and T5 centers use G9, v15 tests prospective fresh-seed replication and horizon transport, not an untouched zero-shot 7B prediction.

hardware_shape_for_future_execution.replicated_adapter_gradient_rule: SUM all-reduce divided by world size before clipping and AdamW

eta_grid.exact_values: enumerated under registered_grids.qwen3p6_27b_lora in the hash-bound gatesim report

qwen3p6_27b_lora_panel.claim_boundary: The 27B common correction extrapolates a two-point full-tuning law into LoRA. Its verdict is secondary and cannot rescue or invalidate either primary 7B gate.

analysis_contract.primary_outcome: finite fixed-development endpoint NLL per supervised token
analysis_contract.curve_estimator: For each model,T,arm fit loss=a*x^2+b*x+c by OLS to the three-seed mean at all six exact x=log2(eta) rungs.
analysis_contract.curve_acceptance: a>0 and the unconstrained vertex lies strictly between min(grid)-0.25 and max(grid)+0.25 log2 bits; INTERIOR and accepted NEAR_BRACKETED statuses are both retained; never clip a vertex

bootstrap.method: shared paired nonparametric training-seed bootstrap across every curve; all six rungs refit
bootstrap.interval: equal-tailed 95% percentile intervals; invalid refits counted, never silently dropped

analysis_contract.arm_relative_error: [log2(eta_raw/eta_mu0)-registered log2 raw/mu0 ratio] at the same model,T; the common c(P) term cancels algebraically
analysis_contract.missing_rule: Any missing, invalid, nonfinite, or unaccepted required curve makes only the gate requiring that curve NOT_EVALUABLE; it cannot force the other independent gate to FAIL.

G15A_7B_ABSOLUTE.pass: at least 5 of the 6 accepted 7B curve point errors have abs(error)<=0.21 bits and at least 8000 shared bootstrap refits are valid
G15A_7B_ABSOLUTE.fail: complete accepted evidence with fewer than 5 of 6 in band
G15A_7B_ABSOLUTE.not_evaluable: any required 7B curve/evidence failure or fewer than 8000 valid shared refits

G15R_7B_ARM_RELATIVE.pass: at least 2 of the 3 7B horizon point errors have abs(error)<=0.16 bits and at least 8000 relative bootstrap refits are valid
G15R_7B_ARM_RELATIVE.fail: complete accepted relative evidence with fewer than 2 of 3 in band
G15R_7B_ARM_RELATIVE.not_evaluable: a ratio-required curve/evidence failure or fewer than 8000 valid relative refits
G15R_7B_ARM_RELATIVE.independence: This verdict is computed and published even when G15A fails or is not evaluable.

G15A_27B_LORA_ABSOLUTE_SECONDARY.pass: at least 3 of 4 accepted 27B-LoRA curve point errors have abs(error)<=0.21 bits

G15R_27B_LORA_RELATIVE_SECONDARY.pass: at least 1 of 2 accepted 27B-LoRA horizon relative errors has abs(error)<=0.16 bits

independent_gates.no_joint_override: There is no omnibus verdict that converts one gate's failure into another gate's failure. All four labels and numeric estimates are reported separately.

gate_feasibility.interpretation: The simulation preserves a shared common-mode term before arm subtraction and applies 1.5x the measured residual scale to LoRA. It validates decision separation and power under the calibrated alternative, not the scientific transport law.

allowed_reasons: registered process timeout without a valid endpoint
retry_contract.retry_unit: all six eta rungs sharing model,T,arm,seed
